name: File Chat HTTP API
description: OpenAI-compatible HTTP chat endpoint that accepts file attachments (base64 or download URL) and returns generated files as local relative paths.

path.description: HTTP route path for the file-chat endpoint

apiKey.description: Optional API key required via X-API-Key header

defaultProvider.description: Default provider override for agent runs

defaultModel.description: Default model override for agent runs

defaultThinking.description: Thinking level passed to the agent run when the request does not specify one

filesRoot.description: Absolute root directory for inbound/outbound files. Defaults to <home>/.openclaw/file-chat/files

inboundDirName.description: Subdirectory name for inbound files (default: inbound)

outboundDirName.description: Subdirectory name for outbound files (default: outbound)

sessionScopedDirs.description: Scope inbound/outbound files under a per-session subdirectory (default: true)

publicPathPrefix.description: Prefix prepended to relative file paths when they are emitted to clients

maxFileBytes.description: Maximum size of a single file in bytes (default: 20971520)

maxFilesPerRequest.description: Maximum number of attached files per request (default: 10)

allowUrlFetch.description: Allow inbound files to be fetched from a download URL (default: true)

appendOutboundFooter.description: Append a footer listing generated files to the assistant reply (default: true)

outboundInstruction.description: Override the system prompt fragment that tells the model where to write generated files
